{{Top|leg}}
A '''sun visor''' was a piece of headgear which could conceal someone's [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] from sunlight, as well as from other people.

In preparation for an [[Assassination attempt on Wedge Antilles|assassination attempt]] to be made on [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] after he officially resigned his commission in the [[Five Worlds]] military, [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|his wife]] prepared a package, including a sun visor, for Antilles to be able to get away unnoticed.<ref name="LotFE">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref> The [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] "[[Gundark (arms dealer)|Gundark]]" sometimes wore a sun visor.<ref name="GFTPG">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
